# Nepal Administrative Data — Full Documentation

> Offline Dart package (`nepal_admin_api` v2.3.0) for Nepal's administrative divisions: 7 provinces, 77 districts, 753 local bodies, 6,743 wards, with official CBS/NSO codes, ward counts, and map coordinates. Pure Dart, zero runtime dependencies. Maintained by namunaONE under HyaMuji and Taire Bhai. Not affiliated with the Government of Nepal.

This file is the complete text companion to `llms.txt`. Sources of truth: the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/namunaONE/Nepal-Local-Government-Data), the [API reference page](https://namunaONE.github.io/Nepal-Local-Government-Data/api.html), and the [package on pub.dev](https://pub.dev/packages/nepal_admin_api).

## Installation

```yaml
dependencies:
  nepal_admin_api: ^2.3.0
```

```bash
dart pub get
# or
flutter pub get
```

```dart
import 'package:nepal_admin_api/nepal_admin_api.dart';
```

## Quickstart

```dart
import 'package:nepal_admin_api/nepal_admin_api.dart';

void main() {
  // Provinces (7). Lookup by slug or ISO 3166-2 code, case-insensitive.
  final provinces = NepalAdminApi.getAllProvinces(); // length 7
  final bagmati = NepalAdminApi.getProvinceById('NP-P3');
  print('${bagmati?.name} CBS:${bagmati?.cbsCode} ISO:${bagmati?.isoCode}');
  // Bagmati CBS:3 ISO:NP-P3

  // Districts (77). By name (case-insensitive) or 3-digit CBS code.
  final chitwan = NepalAdminApi.getDistrictByName('Chitwan');
  print('${chitwan?.localBodyCount} bodies'); // 7
  final kathmandu = NepalAdminApi.getDistrictByCbs(306);

  // Local bodies / palikas (753). By district, province, type, or CBS code.
  final bharatpur = NepalAdminApi.getLocalBodyByCbs(31304)!;
  print('${bharatpur.name} (${bharatpur.typeName})'); // Bharatpur (Metropolitan City)
  print('${bharatpur.fullPath}'); // Bharatpur, Chitwan, Bagmati
  print('CBS:${bharatpur.cbsCode} verified:${bharatpur.cbsCodeVerified}'); // 31304 true
  print('Wards:${bharatpur.wards} verified:${bharatpur.wardsVerified}'); // 29 true
  print('Coords:${bharatpur.lat},${bharatpur.lng}'); // approx. centroid

  // Search returns typed SearchResult(provinces, districts, localBodies).
  // Names are NOT unique: disambiguate with districtName/provinceName.
  for (final lb in NepalAdminApi.search('Sunkoshi').localBodies) {
    print(lb.fullPath);
  }

  // Sorted / filtered lists via extension.
  final metros = NepalAdminApi.getAllLocalBodies().ofType(LocalBodyType.metropolitan); // 6
  final dropdown = NepalAdminApi.getLocalBodiesByDistrict('Chitwan').sortedByName;

  // National totals, computed live.
  final s = NepalAdminApi.getNationalStats();
  print('${s.provinces}/${s.districts}/${s.total}/${s.wards}'); // 7/77/753/6743

  // JSON round-trip (preserves codes, coords, wards).
  final restored = LocalBody.fromJson(bharatpur.toJson());
  assert(restored.cbsCode == 31304);
}
```

## Models

### LocalBodyType (enum)
`metropolitan` (Metro, 6) · `subMetropolitan` (Sub-Metro, 11) · `municipality` (M, 276) · `ruralMunicipality` (RM, 460) · `unknown` (deserialization fallback). `LocalBodyType.fromShort('RM')` resolves abbreviations.

### Province
`id` (slug, e.g. `'koshi'`) · `name` · `cbsCode` (1–7) · `isoCode` (`'NP-P1'`…`'NP-P7'`) · `stats` (`ProvinceStats`) · `districts`. Getters: `localBodies` (flattened), `localBodyCount`.

### District
`name` · `cbsCode` (int?, 3-digit, e.g. 306 Kathmandu) · `provinceName` · `localBodies` · `localBodyCount` · `wards` (sums verified counts) · `localBodiesByType(type)` · `verifiedLocalBodies`.

### LocalBody
`name` · `type` · `districtName` · `provinceName` · `cbsCode` (int?, 5-digit PDDPP, null when unverified) · `cbsCodeVerified` · `lat`/`lng` (double?, WGS84 centroid, null when unmapped) · `geoSource` (e.g. `'open-admin-data'`) · `wards` (int?, null for 8 pending roster adjudication) · `wardsVerified`. Getters: `typeName`, `isUrban`, `isRural`, `hasCoordinates`, `fullPath` (`'Name, District, Province'`). `toJson()` omits nulls; `fromJson()` restores all fields.

### ProvinceStats / NationalStats / SearchResult
`ProvinceStats{districts, metro, subMetro, mun, ruralMun, total, wards}` (+`toJson`). `NationalStats{provinces:7, districts:77, metro:6, subMetro:11, municipalities:276, ruralMunicipalities:460, total:753, wards:6743}`. `SearchResult{provinces, districts, localBodies, isEmpty, length}`.

## Queries (all static on NepalAdminApi)

- `getAllProvinces()` → 7 provinces
- `getProvinceById(id)` → by slug or ISO, case-insensitive, null when unknown
- `getProvinceByIso('NP-P3')`, `getProvinceByCbs(3)`
- `getAllDistricts()` → 77; `getDistrictsByProvince(idOrIso)`; `getDistrictByName('Chitwan')` (case-insensitive); `getDistrictByCbs(306)`
- `getAllLocalBodies()` → 753; `getLocalBodiesByDistrict(name)`; `getLocalBodiesByProvince(idOrIso)`; `getLocalBodiesByType(type)`; `getLocalBodyByCbs(31304)` (null when unverified/absent); `getVerifiedLocalBodies()` (547 CBS-verified)
- `search(query)` → case-insensitive across names, ISO codes, full paths, type names; empty query → empty result
- `getNationalStats()` → computed live, never hardcoded

## List helpers (LocalBodyListX extension)

`sortedByName` · `sortedByFullPath` · `whereUrban` · `whereRural` · `whereVerified` (CBS) · `whereMapped` (has coordinates) · `whereWardsVerified` · `ofType(type)` (named to avoid clashing with Dart's built-in `Iterable.whereType`).

## Code formats

- **CBS PDDPP (5-digit):** 3-digit district code + 2-digit palika number. Example: `31304` = district 313 (Chitwan) + palika 04 (Bharatpur). District codes embed province as first digit (306 = province 3, Kathmandu).
- **ISO 3166-2:** `NP-P1`…`NP-P7` for Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati, Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali, Sudurpashchim.
- **Provinces:** koshi(1), madhesh(2), bagmati(3), gandaki(4), lumbini(5), karnali(6), sudurpashchim(7).

## Data verification (why AI can trust these numbers)

- 5+ independent sources merged (abinrimal, sagautam5, CBS/NSO CSVs, Postal Codes 2025, nepali-geo-pro-max, open-admin-data, MoFAGA directory).
- **CBS codes:** 547/753 doubly-attested (CBS CSV + Postal-2025 agreement); rest null, never guessed.
- **Ward counts:** 745/753 doubly-attested (two 753-row snapshots + province-sum reconciliation; Lumbini 109/109=983 fully reconciled); 1 human decision (Janakpurdham 25); 8 null pending roster adjudication.
- **Coordinates:** 726/753 approximate centroids from vendored open-admin-data extract; 27 null, never fabricated.
- **Devanagari spellings:** 72 conflicts adjudicated (49 MoFAGA-exact, 15 slug-identified, 8 human) — see `data/_stage/adjudications.json`.
- Full audit trail in `data/_stage/`; per-field provenance in `data/SOURCES.md`; pipeline tools in `tool/merge/`.

## Known gaps (do not fill by guessing)

- 8 palikas lack ward counts (MoFAGA-backed roster defects): Manang Naraphu/Neshang, Salyan Dhorchaur, Bajhang Kanda, Udayapur Sunkoshi, Saptari Belhi Chapena, Nuwakot Meghang, Rasuwa Aamachhodingmo.
- 206 palikas lack verified CBS codes; 27 lack coordinates. All surface as `null` with `*Verified == false`.
- Administrative boundaries may change by government decision; dataset is versioned per release (see Changelog).
